topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the key learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how pre-malignant cells undergo Darwinian clonal selection and tumorigenesis through both accumulating genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell model and examine how cellular hierarchy and the cell of origin influence tumor initiation across leukemia and intestinal cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how environmental exposures, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal niches promote malignant growth and maintain established tumors.

topics.label: Technologies for analyzing tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the experimental sequencing and spatial omics technologies used to investigate mutational timing, cellular plasticity, and microenvironmental interactions in tumors.

topics.label: Synthesis of cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates genetic alterations, cell of origin, epigenetics, and microenvironmental signals into a comprehensive framework of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture and previews the next session on cancer therapy.
